To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the diffusion of innovation theory can be used to understand the adoption of mobile technology by healthcare professionals, and that this diffusion differs from that of traditional information system implementations.

(1) the diffusion of mobile clinical applications is being driven by healthcare professionals themselves, (2) healthcare professionals have a strong influence on the development and diffusion of mobile clinical information systems, (3) healthcare professionals are the early adopters of mobile clinical applications and, (4) the use of mobile clinical applications by healthcare professionals is a strong driver for the development of these applications.
Mobile clinical applications are being developed and marketed by healthcare professionals themselves.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the emerging trends of mobile technology in health care and how it will impact on future health information systems.
the diffusion of mobile technology and the impact of the healthcare professional on the diffusion process.
the emerging trend of the healthcare professional as the early adopter, innovator and system developer of mobile clinical applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the diffusion of mobile clinical applications is driven by the early healthcare professionals adopting the applications, who in turn develop them, and market them to other healthcare professionals.
the use of mobile technology by healthcare professionals is a growing trend.
mobile technology is a disruptive technology and the healthcare professional is at the forefront of the disruption.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the mobile technology is not just a tool for healthcare professionals but it has also become a platform for healthcare professional to develop applications for their own use and to improve the care of their patients.
the use of mobile technology in health care is growing at a rapid pace, and the healthcare professionals are leading the way.

mobile clinical applications are being driven by healthcare professionals themselves and that they are developing the applications themselves in an attempt not only to streamline their own work practices but also to improve patient care.
The main takeaway from our work is that
healthcare professionals are not only using mobile applications but are developing them as well.
mobile technology is a powerful tool for healthcare professionals to improve the quality of their work.

the healthcare professional has become the driving force behind the adoption and diffusion of mobile applications and that this is a significant shift in the way that mobile technology is being developed and adopted.
